content.short: Bridge is a stablecoin platform for developers, handling issuance, conversion and global payouts.
content.description: Bridge is a stablecoin payments platform that moves fiat and stablecoins across currencies through a single API. Businesses use it to create digital asset wallets at scale, with on-chain security and gas management handled by Bridge. Cross-border settlement completes in minutes, including into markets that correspondent banking reaches slowly. The platform can also issue USD and Euro accounts to consumers and businesses. Its stablecoin-backed card product is integrated with Stripe Issuing.
